model_meta.description: Inferred concept model of a machine-tool chuck that drives four jaws and uses pivoting rockers to compensate for differing workpiece contact positions.

subsystems.description: Supports the axially movable drive piston, radially movable jaws, and associated mechanisms.
Axially movable drive piston coupled to the respective clamping jaws through interacting helical gearing; the gearing interaction converts axial piston movement into radial jaw feed.

parts.description: Axially movable drive piston with helical gearing

subsystems.description: Four radially movable jaws that engage and center the workpiece; jaw contours may be adapted to the workpiece.

parts.description: Radially movable clamping jaws arranged in pairs

subsystems.description: Pivoting rockers on piston-supported bolts transmit piston movement through guided transmission pins to the jaws and compensate unequal contact/feed positions.
Optional radially displaceable weights coupled through levers to jaws to add clamping force during chuck rotation.
External workpiece held centered for machining; its contour is accommodated by adapted jaws.

item_flows.name: Helical mechanical drive coupling
item_flows.notes: Interacting helical surfaces/gearing couple the axially movable piston to radial jaw movement; transformation occurs within the coupling.

item_flows.name: Piston-supported rocker pivot coupling
item_flows.notes: Rocker is pivotably mounted about a bolt supported on the drive piston.

item_flows.name: Guided transmission-pin coupling
item_flows.notes: Pins couple rocker guide grooves to supported jaws with slight linear movement.

item_flows.name: Weight-to-jaw lever coupling
item_flows.notes: Centrifugal weight is drivably coupled to a jaw through a lever.

actions.name: Drive jaws and compensate contact differences

steps.description: Axial movement of the drive piston transmits force through its helical gearing and the rocker/bolt mechanism.
Helical gearing converts axial piston feed into radial feed of the jaws toward the workpiece.

When jaw contact positions differ, rocker deflection about its piston-supported bolt produces feed compensation; the transmission pins move linearly in the rocker guide grooves to transmit force while allowing relative movement.
Chuck rotation presses the centrifugal weights radially outward.
The levers transmit weight displacement as additional radial clamping force to the respective jaws.

actions.name: Move jaws synchronously away from the workpiece

steps.description: The helical coupling moves the four clamping jaws synchronously away from the workpiece.
